name: Steroid back acne management
lead: Steroid back acne (often called bacne in forums) refers to acne on the back and shoulders that people attribute to anabolic-androgenic steroid or testosterone use. Wikipedia states that anabolic-androgenic steroids and testosterone replacement can cause acne, and describes it as steroid acne [1].
The available reference material is limited to general acne information, and no published trial dedicated to back acne from performance-enhancing steroids was identified.

paras: Androgens such as testosterone and DHT are linked to acne because they increase sebum production, and acne does not develop in people with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome [1]. Conventional acne treatments listed by Wikipedia include topical retinoids, benzoyl peroxide, antibiotics and, for severe acne, isotretinoin [1].

card.summary: Back acne that people link to steroid use; reference material is limited to general acne and androgen information.
card.note: Severe acne is usually managed by clinicians; no dedicated trials found.

quick.overview:
Steroid back acne is acne on the back attributed to anabolic steroids or testosterone. It is a recurring topic in forum protocol discussions.

Thin sourcing is available here, so the article is short.
quick.mechanism: Androgens increase sebum production, which is linked to acne.
quick.risks: Anabolic steroids carry broader legal and health risks; standard acne treatments are listed by general references.
